_comment: Input to L1-design-ux-wireframe, BOM Phase 4. Two inputs per the BOM row: stories.json for the acceptance criteria a screen must satisfy, and user-journeys.md for the touchpoints a screen must exist at. Wireframes are additive — they land in the FDP's additive/ folder and are never merged.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated producer on the registration form
acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a well-formed FBO number
acceptance_criteria.then: the registration is accepted and held with status pending-verification

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated producer on the registration form
acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a malformed FBO number
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission is refused with a field-level message and no registration record is created

acceptance_criteria.when: they submit without having ticked the FBO-status attestation
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission is refused server-side, and the refusal is not bypassable by altering the client request

acceptance_criteria.given: a producer with a registration held pending-verification
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to publish a listing
acceptance_criteria.then: publication is blocked and the producer is told verification is still in progress

stories.title: Asynchronous FBO verification and its outcomes

acceptance_criteria.when: the FBO lookup returns an invalid status
acceptance_criteria.then: the registration is rejected, the producer is notified with the reason, and publication stays blocked

acceptance_criteria.when: the FBO lookup does not answer within its timeout
acceptance_criteria.then: the registration stays pending and is retried; it is never optimistically treated as valid

content.execution_summary: • Cycle 1 acceptance criteria with a user-facing surface.

journeys.title: Producer registers and waits for eligibility

steps.action: Completes the registration form: business details, FBO number, attestation tick
steps.emotional_note: The producer may not have their FBO number to hand. The journey must survive being abandoned here and resumed later.

steps.action: Reads and ticks the FBO-status attestation
steps.note: The UI must not let it feel like boilerplate.

steps.action: Sees an explicit pending state with what happens next
steps.emotional_note: The producer has finished their part and cannot act further. An unexplained wait is read as failure.

steps.action: Attempts to publish while pending; blocked with a stated reason
Lookup times out; producer sees the same pending state
steps.note: A timeout and a slow answer must be indistinguishable to the producer.

findings.summary: TP-04 registration status screen is required by the journey and built by no Work Unit.
No resumption path after abandonment at step 3.

design_constraints.persona_context: Producer, P-01: low technical capability, often on a phone, often outdoors. Source: kb-L2-food-domain FD2.
design_constraints.figma_push_note: tool-L1-figma-create-frame is optional per the BOM row and is not invoked in this run. Wireframes are emitted as ASCII in the markdown artifact so they are readable in a terminal, a diff and a PR review.
